Ajay Prajapati @ Ajay Kumar Prajapati .... Petitioner Versus The State of Jharkhand .... Opposite
Party ....
 Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajesh Kumar
For the Petitioner : Mr. A.K.Chaturvedi, Adv.

For the State : Mr. Sunil Kr. Dubey, A.P.P.
 ....
03/21.02.2023

The applicant, who is in custody since 17.10.2022, has appr Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Daltonganj Town P.S. Case No.118 of 2022,
registered for the offence under Sections 323, 354, 376, 504, 506, 511 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 8/ 12 of the POCSO Act.
It appears that the applicant has been made an accused of attempting rape upon the victim girl, aged about 16 years, who is next door neighbour of the applicant.

It has been submitted by learned counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of F.I.R. alongwith its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on his/her part.
Innocence of the applicant has been claimed and undertaking has been given for participation in the trial.

It has been submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the co-accused, namely, Suraj Kumar has already been enlarged on bail by this Court vide order dated 05.08.2022 passed in B.A.
No.7697 of 2022.
On above basis, prayer for bail has been made.
Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail of the applicant.

Considering the period of custody, the applicant, named above, is directed to be released on bail, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand Only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Exclusive Special Judge, POCSO Act, Palamau in connection with Daltonganj Town P.S. Case No.118 of 2022, subject to condition that one of the bailors will be the close relative of the applicant and he will report once in a month to the concerned Ajay Prajapati @ Ajay Kumar Prajapati vs The State Of Jharkhand ....
